ipa.surfaces.swaption.SwaptionSurfaceDefinition

The definition of the volatility surface.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.surfaces.swaption.SwaptionSurfaceDefinition.

Syntax

SwaptionSurfaceDefinition(
    *,
    instrument_code: OptStr = None,
    discounting_type: DiscountingType | None = None,
    index_name: OptStr = None,
    index_tenor: OptStr = None,
    underlying_swap_structure: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument_code OptStr No None The currency of the interest rate volatility model.
discounting_type DiscountingType | None No None The discounting type of the interest rate volatility model. the default value is selected based on 'instrumentcode'.
index_name OptStr No None Underlying index name (e.g. 'euribor').
index_tenor OptStr No None Index tenor of the projected zero curve used to calculate swap rates. the default value is the index tenor associated with the underlying swap structure (for eur_ab6e, 6m).
underlying_swap_structure OptStr No None Underlying swap structure, eg: eur_ab6e
